focus.title: 美国拟对东南亚四国光伏产品加征反倾销税，中国企业需审慎评估供应链布局
focus.summary: 美国商务部初步裁定，对来自越南、泰国、马来西亚和柬埔寨的光伏产品征收反倾销税，税率在10%至125%不等。此举旨在遏制中国光伏企业通过东南亚转口规避关税的行为。相关企业应立即审查原产地规则与供应链合规性，考虑调整生产基地或申请税率排除。
focus.title_en: U.S. Proposes Anti-Dumping Duties on Solar Products from Four Southeast Asian Countries, Chinese Enterprises Urged to Reassess Supply Chains
focus.summary_en: The U.S. Department of Commerce preliminarily ruled to impose anti-dumping duties on solar products from Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, and Cambodia, with rates ranging from 10% to 125%. The move aims to curb Chinese solar firms circumventing tariffs via Southeast Asia. Companies should review rules of origin and supply chain compliance, and consider adjusting production bases or seeking duty exclusions.

case.title: 香港仲裁庭认定“一带一路”项目适用英国法，中国承包方因工期延误索赔获部分支持
case.summary: 香港国际仲裁中心就一起中资企业在巴基斯坦的公路建设项目争议作出裁决，认定合同适用英国法，中国承包方因业主方征地延迟导致工期延误的索赔请求部分成立，获赔约320万美元。此案提示中国企业：境外合同中应明确法律适用与不可抗力条款，并保留完整证据链。
case.source: 来源：香港国际仲裁中心 · 2026年6月
case.title_en: Hong Kong Tribunal Applies English Law to Belt and Road Project, Awards Partial Compensation to Chinese Contractor for Delay
case.summary_en: The HKIAC ruled on a dispute involving a Chinese contractor's highway project in Pakistan, applying English law. The tribunal partially upheld the contractor's claim for delay caused by the employer's land acquisition issues, awarding approximately USD 3.2 million. The case highlights the need for clear governing law and force majeure clauses in overseas contracts, and meticulous evidence preservation.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动“白名单”扩围，新增医疗与金融领域试点
policy.summary: 广东省网信办联合港澳相关部门发布通知，将大湾区数据跨境流动试点范围扩大至医疗健康与金融领域。纳入“白名单”的企业在履行安全评估后，可便利地跨境传输指定类型数据。此举将降低合规成本，促进跨境医疗服务与金融科技合作。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026年6月30日
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Expands Cross-Border Data Flow 'White List' to Include Healthcare and Finance Pilots
policy.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong, together with Hong Kong and Macau authorities, announced an expansion of the cross-border data flow pilot program to cover healthcare and financial sectors. Companies on the 'white list' can transfer designated data types across borders after security assessments, reducing compliance costs and facilitating cross-border medical services and fintech collaboration.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong · June 30, 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期合规准备要点
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟CBAM已进入过渡期，中国出口商需在2026年底前提交首批季度报告。建议企业：1) 建立产品碳足迹核算体系；2) 区分直接排放与间接排放；3) 保留第三方核查报告。未能合规将面临每吨二氧化碳当量100欧元的罚款。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Key Compliance Steps for EU CBAM Transition Period
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The EU CBAM is in its transitional phase, with the first quarterly reports due by end of 2026. Companies should: 1) establish product carbon footprint accounting; 2) distinguish direct and indirect emissions; 3) retain third-party verification reports. Non-compliance may result in penalties of €100 per tonne of CO2 equivalent.
